name: Operational-ROI benchmark
description: Requirement-conditioned operational ROI grounding on CAD B-Rep models: 300 natural-language inspection requirements paired with Target / Context / Envelope reference annotations, the selections made by 84 system configurations, and the metrics behind every published table. Everything here is derived from a working research tree that is ~12 GB. This repository keeps the fields that reproduce the published numbers and drops the per-case agent traces and per-measurement-point executor output. The scripts that performed the reduction are included, and the reduction is verified: the scoring script reproduces all published RQ1 and RQ2 values from the files in this repository alone.
